subject: BMAD-METHOD
tagline: Agile AI-driven development: named personas + numbered phase skills turn an idea into working software without dropping the thinking.

capabilities.name: Named persona skills
capabilities.description: Winston/John/Amelia etc. with 3-layer TOML merge and a menu that dispatches other skills.

capabilities.name: Party Mode
capabilities.description: session/auto/subagent/agent-team roundtables; memlog is dynamics not transcript.

capabilities.name: Numbered agile pipeline
capabilities.description: Analysis → PRD/UX/SPEC → architecture/epics → build/review, each as a skill with steps/.

capabilities.name: Skill validator
capabilities.description: Deterministic CI validator for skill frontmatter and structure.

capabilities.name: Persistent facts + project-context
capabilities.description: file: globs and literal facts loaded on persona activation.

capabilities.name: Customization layers
capabilities.description: skill default → team toml → user toml.

plugins.mechanism: customize.toml + install into IDE skill trees

unique_selling_points: Personas you talk to, not agent-3
YAML+MD skill DSL with a validator
Party Mode is for disagreement, not consensus

limitations.description: No own runtime state backend — lives in the host IDE
No token budgets, no plugin marketplace
